task.description: Implement GH #507 (ISS-0178, MAJOR): add a CI job that builds from a genuinely clean checkout (no restored build cache, no reused workspace) and runs `zig build test-lua` to completion, so untracked-but-required build inputs (the ISS-0175/#503 luajit_relver.txt class) and path-dependent escaping bugs (the ISS-0177/#506 dynasm class) are caught by CI before merge, not discovered later by a human running a manual git clone. This is a .github/workflows/ci.yml change (the only workflow file in this repo), not Zig source code. Acceptance criteria per the issue: (1) fresh checkout, no cache restore, no workspace reuse -- must NOT reuse the existing 'Build and unit tests' job's Zig cache-restore step; (2) builds zig build test-lua to completion; (3) MUST fail if a required build input is absent from tracked git contents -- verify this by mutation testing (temporarily re-add luajit_relver.txt to .gitignore or remove it from tracked contents in a scratch test, confirm the new job goes red while the existing cached job stays green, then revert the mutation -- do NOT leave the repo in a mutated state); (4) runs on pull_request events targeting main; (5) if feasible without excessive runtime cost, the clean-checkout working directory path should contain a character sequence that would be an invalid C escape (e.g. a path component starting with c, s, or U) so the ISS-0177 path-escaping class is also covered, not just the missing-tracked-file class -- GitHub Actions runners' default checkout path may or may not already satisfy this; investigate and use a custom checkout path if needed (actions/checkout@v4's 'path' input).
acceptance_criteria: New CI job added to .github/workflows/ci.yml that checks out fresh with no cache restore and no workspace reuse
Job runs zig build test-lua to completion
Mutation-tested: confirmed the job goes red when a required tracked build input is removed, then the mutation was reverted (repo left clean)
Job triggers on pull_request events targeting main
Clean-checkout path includes an invalid-C-escape character sequence if feasible without excessive runtime cost, to also cover the ISS-0177 path-escaping class
Existing Build and unit tests job unaffected/unchanged in behavior

result.summary: Added a new 'Clean-checkout LuaJIT build (test-lua)' job to .github/workflows/ci.yml, running on ubuntu-latest in its own job (GitHub Actions gives every job in a workflow an independently-provisioned VM by platform guarantee, so no cache/workspace state can carry over from the 'Build and unit tests' job even before the further precautions below). The job: (1) checks out fresh via actions/checkout@v4 with no fetch-depth override and no restored artifact; (2) installs Zig via mlugg/setup-zig@v2 with 'use-cache: false' explicitly, since that action defaults to true and would otherwise restore a persistent actions/cache keyed on the Zig version -- the exact state-carryover mechanism the issue is about, even though no actions/cache step is visible directly in ci.yml; (3) runs `zig build test-lua -j2` to completion; (4) is covered by the workflow-level `on: pull_request: branches: [main]` trigger already in ci.yml, so no per-job trigger was needed. Existing 'Build and unit tests' job is byte-for-byte unchanged -- `git diff --stat` shows 78 insertions, 0 deletions in ci.yml. Mutation-tested locally (not in real CI, since this session cannot trigger/observe an Actions run): cloned the current branch (commit 214992b) into a scratch directory via `git clone` (a genuine fresh clone, not a worktree), ran `zig build test-lua` with an isolated/never-before-used cache dir to simulate a cold CI runner -- baseline passed 71/71 tests. Then deleted vendor/luajit/src/luajit_relver.txt from that clone only (the ISS-0175 regression class) and rebuilt with a second fresh, never-used cache dir: the build failed exactly as the new CI job would -- "error: failed to check cache: '...luajit_relver.txt' file_hash FileNotFound", Build Summary 4/16 steps succeeded (1 failed), exit code 1. The scratch clone was deleted afterward; `git status --porcelain` on the real tracked repo shows only the intended ci.yml edit, confirming no mutation touched tracked content. Criterion 4 (invalid-C-escape path sequence) was investigated and found structurally inapplicable to the current runner: ISS-0177's dynasm bug only manifests via BACKSLASH path separators, and every job in this workflow (existing and new) runs on ubuntu-latest, whose checkout paths use forward slashes exclusively -- there is no backslash for a `path:` input to place a `\c`/`\s`/`\U` sequence into on that OS. Reproducing this class would require adding a windows-latest runner, a materially larger cost (extra toolchain fetch + full native build on every PR) than this issue's scope; documented as an explicit follow-up in the new job's comment block rather than silently skipped. Status is PARTIAL, not PASS, for two reasons: (a) the mutation test is a strong local approximation (real git clone, real fresh cache, real zig build test-lua, real failure reproduced) but was not observed inside an actual GitHub Actions run of this new job -- that still needs confirming once this PR's own CI executes; (b) criterion 4 is met by documented investigation and reasoned inapplicability on ubuntu-latest, not by an executed positive test, since no backslash-path runner exists in this workflow.
result.next_action: Route to TEST-RUNNER (Step 5) to observe the new clean_checkout_lua_build job execute for real once this PR's CI runs, and confirm it goes green on the current tree (positive case) -- the mutation/negative case was already verified locally in this step and is documented above, not left for TEST-RUNNER to redo. No further design ambiguity remains; this is a CI-workflow-only change with a fully specified target.
